package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
)

const schemaDDL = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT,
    full_name TEXT,
    phone TEXT,
    roles TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    qualifications TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    certifications JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    assigned_location_id UUID,
    available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
    assignment_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    recent_declines INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    latest_latitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    latest_longitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    location_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
    token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    active_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sample_types (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    qualified_collector_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    required_qualification TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    incompatible_sample_types UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    requires_cooled_route BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    batching_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    coverage_km DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.0,
    handling_minutes INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 15,
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    function_collection_point BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    function_transfer_point BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    function_hub BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    function_laboratory BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cooled_capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
    cooled_reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    accepted_sample_types UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS connections (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    from_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    to_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    travel_minutes INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
    cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,
    cooled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
    reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cooled_capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 20,
    cooled_reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS serviceability_snapshots (
    version INT PRIMARY KEY,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
    computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    network_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_collection_point_count INT NOT NULL,
    regions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collection_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    requester_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    origin_lat DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    origin_lng DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    origin_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home',
    origin_node_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id),
    sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(id),
    requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    delivery_deadline TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    earliest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    latest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    incompatible_sample_types UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    serviceability TEXT NOT NULL,
    serviceability_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id),
    journey_id UUID,
    sample_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS samples (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    request_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES collection_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    requester_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(id),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested',
    sealed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    sealed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    current_holder_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    active_journey_id UUID,
    target_laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id),
    received_laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id),
    received_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    handling_compliant BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    exception JSONB,
    pending_handoff_id UUID,
    latest_latitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    latest_longitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    location_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journeys (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    parent_journey_id UUID REFERENCES journeys(id),
    plan_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    route_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct',
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    replan_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required',
    estimated_delivery_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    total_cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    capacity_used INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    capacity_available INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
    sample_ids UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journey_stops (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
    stop_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INT NOT NULL,
    estimated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    dwell_minutes INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journey_legs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sequence INT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    from_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
    to_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
    worker_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    sample_id UUID REFERENCES samples(id),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'transport',
    offer_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    declined_worker_ids UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS handoffs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    from_assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journey_legs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    to_assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journey_legs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    receiver_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    current_holder_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
    sender_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    sender_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    receiver_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    receiver_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS handling_checkpoints (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journey_legs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    location_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id),
    actor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_temperature_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    compliant BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    sample_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS disruptions (

func Migrate(db *sql.DB) error {
	_, err := db.Exec(schemaDDL)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migration failed: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func ResetDatabase(db *sql.DB) error {
	dropQuery := `
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS realtime_events CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS idempotency_keys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS audit_log CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS capacity_reservations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS disruptions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handling_checkpoints CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handoffs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_legs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_stops CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journeys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS samples CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS collection_requests CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS serviceability_snapshots CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS connections CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS locations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sample_types CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;
    `
	if _, err := db.Exec(dropQuery); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := Migrate(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migrate after drop failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := SeedInitialData(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed initial data failed: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

func EnsureInitialAdmin(db *sql.DB) error {
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if adminUser == "" {
		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "admin123"
	}

	var count int
	err := db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").Scan(&count)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if count == 0 {
		hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(adminPass), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		allRoles := []string{
			"administrator",
			"dispatcher",
			"requester",
			"collection_professional",
			"delivery_partner",
			"node_handler",
			"laboratory_team",
		}
		allQuals := []string{"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse", "certified_collector"}
		certs := []map[string]interface{}{
			{"code": "Amber", "active": true},
			{"code": "Indigo", "active": true},
			{"code": "Frost", "active": true},
			{"code": "Pulse", "active": true},
		}
		certBytes, _ := json.Marshal(certs)

		var centralLabId string
		_ = db.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE function_laboratory = true LIMIT 1").Scan(&centralLabId)

		_, err = db.Exec(`
            INSERT INTO users (id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone, roles, qualifications, certifications, active, assigned_location_id, available, capacity_units, assignment_count)
            VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, 'admin@labsystem.local', 'Initial Administrator', '+91-9876543210', $3, $4, $5, true, $6, true, 20, 0)
        `, adminUser, string(hash), allRoles, allQuals, string(certBytes), centralLabId)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert initial admin: %w", err)
		}
		log.Printf("Created initial administrator: %s", adminUser)
	}
	return nil
}

    actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    actor_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    success BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    details JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_keys (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    response_code INT NOT NULL,
    response_body JSONB NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS realtime_events (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Indexes for performance & quick lookups
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_user_id ON sessions(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journey_stops_journey_id ON journey_stops(journey_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journey_legs_journey_id ON journey_legs(journey_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journey_legs_worker_id ON journey_legs(worker_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_handoffs_sample_id ON handoffs(sample_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_log_actor ON audit_log(actor_id);

`

func Migrate(db *sql.DB) error {
	_, err := db.Exec(schemaDDL)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migration failed: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func ResetDatabase(db *sql.DB) error {
	dropQuery := `
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS realtime_events CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS idempotency_keys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS audit_log CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS capacity_reservations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS disruptions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handling_checkpoints CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handoffs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_legs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_stops CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journeys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS samples CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS collection_requests CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS serviceability_snapshots CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS connections CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS locations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sample_types CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;
    `
	if _, err := db.Exec(dropQuery); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := Migrate(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migrate after drop failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := SeedInitialData(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed initial data failed: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

        VALUES ($1, 'Pulse', true, 'Pulse', 'Rapid', 10.0, 30.0, $2, false, false)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
    `, pulseId, []string{})

	_, err = db.Exec(`

        VALUES ($1, 'Bangalore Central Lab & Hub', 12.9716, 77.5946, 5.0, 15, true, true, true, true, true, 200, 0, 100, 0, $2)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
    `, centralLabId, allSampleTypes)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// North Node
	_, err = db.Exec(`
        INSERT INTO locations (id, name, latitude, longitude, coverage_km, handling_minutes, active, function_collection_point, function_transfer_point, function_hub, function_laboratory, capacity_units, reserved_units, cooled_capacity_units, cooled_reserved_units, accepted_sample_types)
        VALUES ($1, 'North Bangalore Clinic & Node', 13.0050, 77.5800, 5.0, 10, true, true, true, false, false, 100, 0, 50, 0, '{}')
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
    `, northNodeId)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// South Hub
	_, err = db.Exec(`
        INSERT INTO locations (id, name, latitude, longitude, coverage_km, handling_minutes, active, function_collection_point, function_transfer_point, function_hub, function_laboratory, capacity_units, reserved_units, cooled_capacity_units, cooled_reserved_units, accepted_sample_types)
        VALUES ($1, 'South Bangalore Hub', 12.9350, 77.6100, 5.0, 15, true, true, true, true, false, 150, 0, 80, 0, '{}')
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
    `, southHubId)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// East Lab
	_, err = db.Exec(`
        INSERT INTO locations (id, name, latitude, longitude, coverage_km, handling_minutes, active, function_collection_point, function_transfer_point, function_hub, function_laboratory, capacity_units, reserved_units, cooled_capacity_units, cooled_reserved_units, accepted_sample_types)
        VALUES ($1, 'East Diagnostic Lab', 12.9800, 77.6400, 5.0, 20, true, true, false, false, true, 150, 0, 80, 0, $2)

    `, eastLabId, allSampleTypes)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// West Node
	_, err = db.Exec(`
        INSERT INTO locations (id, name, latitude, longitude, coverage_km, handling_minutes, active, function_collection_point, function_transfer_point, function_hub, function_laboratory, capacity_units, reserved_units, cooled_capacity_units, cooled_reserved_units, accepted_sample_types)
        VALUES ($1, 'West Collection Point', 12.9600, 77.5400, 5.0, 10, true, true, true, false, false, 100, 0, 50, 0, '{}')
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
    `, westNodeId)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Seed Connections
	connections := []struct {
		from   uuid.UUID

	_, err = db.Exec(`

        VALUES (1, 'published', NOW(), $1, 5, $2)
        ON CONFLICT (version) DO NOTHING
    `, uuid.New().String(), string(regBytes))
	if err != nil {
		return err

	return nil

func EnsureInitialAdmin(db *sql.DB) error {
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if adminUser == "" {
		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "admin123"
	}

	var count int
	err := db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").Scan(&count)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if count == 0 {
		hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(adminPass), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		allRoles := []string{
			"administrator",
			"dispatcher",
			"requester",
			"collection_professional",
			"delivery_partner",
			"node_handler",
			"laboratory_team",
		}
		allQuals := []string{"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse", "certified_collector"}
		certs := []map[string]interface{}{
			{"code": "Amber", "active": true},
			{"code": "Indigo", "active": true},
			{"code": "Frost", "active": true},
			{"code": "Pulse", "active": true},
		}
		certBytes, _ := json.Marshal(certs)

		var centralLabId string
		_ = db.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE function_laboratory = true LIMIT 1").Scan(&centralLabId)

		_, err = db.Exec(`
            INSERT INTO users (id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone, roles, qualifications, certifications, active, assigned_location_id, available, capacity_units, assignment_count)
            VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, 'admin@labsystem.local', 'Initial Administrator', '+91-9876543210', $3, $4, $5, true, $6, true, 20, 0)
        `, adminUser, string(hash), allRoles, allQuals, string(certBytes), centralLabId)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert initial admin: %w", err)
		}
		log.Printf("Created initial administrator: %s", adminUser)
	}
	return nil
}

package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/lib/pq"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"
)

const schemaDDL = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT,
    full_name TEXT,
    phone TEXT,
    roles TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    qualifications TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    certifications JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    assigned_location_id UUID,
    available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
    assignment_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    recent_declines INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    latest_latitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    latest_longitude DOUBLE PRECISION,
    location_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
    token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    active_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sample_types (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    qualified_collector_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    required_qualification TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    incompatible_sample_types UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    requires_cooled_route BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    batching_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    coverage_km DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.0,
    handling_minutes INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 15,
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    function_collection_point BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    function_transfer_point BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    function_hub BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    function_laboratory BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cooled_capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
    cooled_reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    accepted_sample_types UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS connections (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    from_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    to_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    travel_minutes INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 30,
    cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,
    cooled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 50,
    reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cooled_capacity_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 20,
    cooled_reserved_units INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS serviceability_snapshots (
    version INT PRIMARY KEY,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published',
    computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    network_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
    active_collection_point_count INT NOT NULL,
    regions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collection_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    requester_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    origin_lat DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    origin_lng DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    origin_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home',
    origin_node_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id),
    sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(id),
    requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    delivery_deadline TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    earliest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    latest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
    incompatible_sample_types UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    serviceability TEXT NOT NULL,
    serviceability_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_laboratory_id UUID REFERENCES locations(id),
    journey_id UUID,
    sample_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

func Migrate(db *sql.DB) error {
	_, err := db.Exec(schemaDDL)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migration failed: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func ResetDatabase(db *sql.DB) error {
	dropQuery := `
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS realtime_events CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS idempotency_keys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS audit_log CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS capacity_reservations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS disruptions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handling_checkpoints CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handoffs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_legs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_stops CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journeys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS samples CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS collection_requests CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS serviceability_snapshots CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS connections CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS locations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sample_types CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;
    `
	if _, err := db.Exec(dropQuery); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := Migrate(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migrate after drop failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := SeedInitialData(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed initial data failed: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

func EnsureInitialAdmin(db *sql.DB) error {
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if adminUser == "" {
		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "admin123"
	}

	var count int
	err := db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").Scan(&count)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if count == 0 {
		hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(adminPass), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		allRoles := []string{
			"administrator",
			"dispatcher",
			"requester",
			"collection_professional",
			"delivery_partner",
			"node_handler",
			"laboratory_team",
		}
		allQuals := []string{"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse", "certified_collector"}
		certs := []map[string]interface{}{
			{"code": "Amber", "active": true},
			{"code": "Indigo", "active": true},
			{"code": "Frost", "active": true},
			{"code": "Pulse", "active": true},
		}
		certBytes, _ := json.Marshal(certs)

		var centralLabId string
		_ = db.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE function_laboratory = true LIMIT 1").Scan(&centralLabId)

		_, err = db.Exec(`
            INSERT INTO users (id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone, roles, qualifications, certifications, active, assigned_location_id, available, capacity_units, assignment_count)
            VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, 'admin@labsystem.local', 'Initial Administrator', '+91-9876543210', $3, $4, $5, true, $6, true, 20, 0)
        `, adminUser, string(hash), allRoles, allQuals, string(certBytes), centralLabId)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert initial admin: %w", err)
		}
		log.Printf("Created initial administrator: %s", adminUser)
	}
	return nil
}

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    replan_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required',
    estimated_delivery_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    total_cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    capacity_used INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    capacity_available INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
    sample_ids UUID[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journey_stops (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    stop_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence INT NOT NULL,

    longitude DOUBLE PRECISION,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journey_legs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    from_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),
    to_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id),

    sample_id UUID REFERENCES samples(id),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'transport',
    offer_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS handoffs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    from_assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journey_legs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    to_assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journey_legs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    receiver_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS handling_checkpoints (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS disruptions (

func Migrate(db *sql.DB) error {
	_, err := db.Exec(schemaDDL)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migration failed: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func ResetDatabase(db *sql.DB) error {
	dropQuery := `
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS realtime_events CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS idempotency_keys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS audit_log CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS capacity_reservations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS disruptions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handling_checkpoints CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS handoffs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_legs CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journey_stops CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS journeys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS samples CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS collection_requests CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS serviceability_snapshots CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS connections CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS locations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sample_types CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;
    `
	if _, err := db.Exec(dropQuery); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := Migrate(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migrate after drop failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := SeedInitialData(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed initial data failed: %w", err)
	}

	return nil
}

func SeedInitialData(db *sql.DB) error {
	// Seed Sample Types: Amber, Indigo, Frost, Pulse
	amberId := uuid.MustParse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")
	indigoId := uuid.MustParse("10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002")

	_, err := db.Exec(`

        VALUES ($1, 'Amber', true, 'Amber', 'Standard', 15.0, 25.0, $2, false, true)

    `, amberId, pq.Array([]string{indigoId.String()}))

		return err
	}

	_, err = db.Exec(`

	if err != nil {

	}

	// North Node
	_, err = db.Exec(`
        INSERT INTO locations (id, name, latitude, longitude, coverage_km, handling_minutes, active, function_collection_point, function_transfer_point, function_hub, function_laboratory, capacity_units, reserved_units, cooled_capacity_units, cooled_reserved_units, accepted_sample_types)
        VALUES ($1, 'North Bangalore Clinic & Node', 13.0050, 77.5800, 5.0, 10, true, true, true, false, false, 100, 0, 50, 0, '{}')
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
    `, northNodeId)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// South Hub
	_, err = db.Exec(`
        INSERT INTO locations (id, name, latitude, longitude, coverage_km, handling_minutes, active, function_collection_point, function_transfer_point, function_hub, function_laboratory, capacity_units, reserved_units, cooled_capacity_units, cooled_reserved_units, accepted_sample_types)

    `, uuid.New().String(), string(regBytes))

	return nil

func EnsureInitialAdmin(db *sql.DB) error {
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if adminUser == "" {
		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "admin123"
	}

	var count int
	err := db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").Scan(&count)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if count == 0 {
		hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(adminPass), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		allRoles := []string{
			"administrator",
			"dispatcher",
			"requester",
			"collection_professional",
			"delivery_partner",
			"node_handler",
			"laboratory_team",
		}
		allQuals := []string{"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse", "certified_collector"}
		certs := []map[string]interface{}{
			{"code": "Amber", "active": true},
			{"code": "Indigo", "active": true},
			{"code": "Frost", "active": true},
			{"code": "Pulse", "active": true},
		}
		certBytes, _ := json.Marshal(certs)

		var centralLabId string
		_ = db.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM locations WHERE function_laboratory = true LIMIT 1").Scan(&centralLabId)

		_, err = db.Exec(`
            INSERT INTO users (id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone, roles, qualifications, certifications, active, assigned_location_id, available, capacity_units, assignment_count)
            VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, 'admin@labsystem.local', 'Initial Administrator', '+91-9876543210', $3, $4, $5, true, $6, true, 20, 0)
        `, adminUser, string(hash), allRoles, allQuals, string(certBytes), centralLabId)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert initial admin: %w", err)
		}
		log.Printf("Created initial administrator: %s", adminUser)
	}
	return nil
}

func Migrate(db *sql.DB) error {

}

func ResetDatabase(db *sql.DB) error {
	dropQuery := `
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS realtime_events CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS idempotency_keys CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS audit_log CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS capacity_reservations CASCADE;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS samples CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS collection_requests CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS serviceability_snapshots CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS connections CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS locations CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sample_types CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sessions CASCADE;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;
    `
	if _, err := db.Exec(dropQuery); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := Migrate(db); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("migrate after drop failed: %w", err)
	}

	if err := SeedInitialData(db); err != nil {

func EnsureInitialAdmin(db *sql.DB) error {
	adminUser := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	adminPass := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")

		adminUser = "admin"
	}
	if adminPass == "" {
		adminPass = "admin123"
	}

	var count int
	err := db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").Scan(&count)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if count == 0 {
		hash, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(adminPass), bcrypt.DefaultCost)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		allRoles := []string{
			"administrator",
			"dispatcher",
			"requester",
			"collection_professional",
			"delivery_partner",
			"node_handler",
			"laboratory_team",
		}
		allQuals := []string{"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse", "certified_collector"}
		certs := []map[string]interface{}{
			{"code": "Amber", "active": true},
			{"code": "Indigo", "active": true},
			{"code": "Frost", "active": true},
			{"code": "Pulse", "active": true},
		}
		certBytes, _ := json.Marshal(certs)

		var centralLabId sql.NullString
		_ = db.QueryRow("SELECT id::text FROM locations WHERE function_laboratory = true LIMIT 1").Scan(&centralLabId)

		var locId interface{} = nil
		if centralLabId.Valid && centralLabId.String != "" {
			locId = centralLabId.String
		}

		_, err = db.Exec(`
            INSERT INTO users (id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone, roles, qualifications, certifications, active, assigned_location_id, available, capacity_units, assignment_count)
            VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, $2, 'admin@labsystem.local', 'Initial Administrator', '+91-9876543210', $3, $4, $5, true, $6, true, 20, 0)
        `, adminUser, string(hash), pq.Array(allRoles), pq.Array(allQuals), string(certBytes), locId)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("failed to insert initial admin: %w", err)
		}
		log.Printf("Created initial administrator: %s", adminUser)
	}
	return nil
